description: Tallow Fen wave 3 — NEUTRAL OBJECTS in the locked style descriptor. This is the content/style-separation set for the style LoRA (the style-on-neutral-subjects trick): mundane folkloric objects rendered in the studio painterly style so the LoRA binds the STYLE to the trigger and attributes creature content to captions. Backgrounds deliberately varied (the white-background reg-set gotcha from the Chroma runs). One lantern subject is INCLUDED on purpose so 'lantern' is captionable content, not an uncaptioned style residue.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, a single warm lantern light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

defaults.negative: anime, manga, cartoon, cel shading, chibi, cute, photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth CG, human person, creature, monster, animal, modern gear, gun, text, watermark, frame, border, signature
